title: TCP ICE candidates are serialized without required tcptype
test: tests/whip.test.js: "WHIP answer gives a TCP ICE candidate its tcptype, and leaves the UDP candidate line unchanged" and "WHIP answer uses the candidate tcpType, and defaults a TCP candidate without one to passive"
proof: Both tests failed on the unchanged serializer: the TCP lines came out as 'a=candidate:1 1 TCP 2130706431 192.0.2.10 40001 typ host' with no tcptype. After the fix the TCP line ends 'typ host tcptype passive' (or the candidate's tcpType, e.g. 'active'), and UDP lines are unchanged. node --test tests/whip.test.js 38/38 after the fix (36 before, plus 2 new); npm test 848/848; lint and typecheck pass.
